Install collie on Omarchy

Phone web UI for the AI agents running in your terminal, served over Tailscale (official binary release)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add collie-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.22.4-1:
    pacman -Qi collie-bin

Open and use collie

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql collie-bin

No special requirements are documented for collie.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install collie on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add collie-bin. The download is 40.8 MB and it takes 94.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is collie free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall collie?

Run omarchy pkg drop collie-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does collie depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: glibc, bash. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is collie in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as collie-bin (version 1.22.4-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. AltanS makes it. Project site: https://github.com/AltanS/collie.
